correctness.rationale: For distinct roots u,v on the unit circle the multiplier difference is (u−v)(a+b(u+v)). At a collision u+v is real nonzero; conjugation gives u+v=(u+v)/(uv), so v=u^{-1}. The smaller positive index k lies strictly between n/4 and n/2, and −2cos(2πk/n) increases strictly there, yielding exactly one colliding pair at each bias and the floor count. Rational ratios a/b make u+v a rational algebraic integer in (−2,0), hence −1, equivalent to a primitive third root. Density and the endpoint 2/3 follow from fractions k/n dense in (1/4,1/2) and the strictly increasing continuous bias map onto (0,2/3). With F_{x,j}=ζ^{xj}, the zero observation row has Fourier coefficients all one and OF=V. The ordered Vandermonde quotient is exactly the product of a+b(ζ^j+ζ^ℓ) over unordered pairs, without an undetermined sign. For each cyclic distance d<n/2 there are n pairs indexed by j; their product is a^n−(−b(1+ζ^d))^n and (1+ζ^d)^n=(−1)^d(2cos(πd/n))^n. Even antipodal pairs produce a^{n/2}. The product is a symmetric polynomial in the integral roots and hence has integer coefficients, with one linear degree per pair; FF*=nI gives |det V|²=n^n Q_n². A unique vanishing linear factor along b=1−a has strictly positive derivative, so every interior zero is simple. The remaining Vandermonde columns are independent and the sole complex relation is a frequency difference, giving the real sine kernel after Fourier inversion of the coordinates. At k=n/3 the pair has sum −1 and distance √3, and all other gaps stay separated locally for fixed n. The n=2 antipodal formula gives a; direct one-site rows at n=3 give det O=a³−b³. The frozen checker was inspected, not run.

value.rationale: The determinant is a natural exact volume for recovery of Fourier modes from time samples at one site. The result identifies precisely how much information is lost (one real sine mode), where it is lost for every cycle length and positive bias, and how the resonant pair opens near equal weights. This is an all-parameter structural answer rather than an arbitrarily selected determinant value or reconstruction claim.
